message:
Now let me compile and test this. I need to copy the test file to the build environment and compile it there.

<｜｜DSML｜｜

<function=execute_bash>
<parameter=command>cd /workspace && bash build.sh 'cp /workspace/test_poc.c /gt/_work/src/ && cd /gt/_work/src && gcc -g -fsanitize=address -Iinclude -I. -Isnmplib test_poc.c snmplib/.libs/libnetsnmp.a -lm -o test_poc 2>&1 | tail -20'</parameter>
</｜｜DSML｜｜
